criteria.rationale: Born February 15, 1977, the patient was 49 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The requested Wegovy order and the primary care plan identify treatment of obesity for chronic weight management.
The August 19 note documents a portion-controlled, approximately 1,800-kcal/day diet and walking 30 minutes three days weekly, with a plan to continue both alongside Wegovy.

The August 19 note documents continuous participation since mid-December 2025 in a dietitian-led program with a food diary, reduced-calorie eating, walking, and monthly check-ins—more than six whole calendar months.
The latest structured BMI before the request was 36.8 kg/m², exceeding the 30 kg/m² threshold without needing a comorbidity.

parsed.summary: All five modeled criteria are met. The patient has a qualifying BMI and documented ongoing diet, activity, and more than six months of continuous dietitian-led program participation.
